question: Which other classes of beings are included in this encompassing vision, O beloved?
premises: Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are included
inference: The vision also encompasses Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas
plain_english: O beloved, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
